newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 600 bln Ffr BTANs, OATs in 1997.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 600 bln Ffr BTANs, OATs in 1997.

text.p: France plans to issue about 600 billion francs of medium and long-term debt in 1997, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.
The government plans to issue 280 billion francs of medium-term BTANs and 320 billion francs of longer-term OATs, the ministry said in a statement.

The finance ministry said BTAN repayments would total 167.5 billion francs and OAT repayments would amount to 185.6 billion francs. These figures take account of 23 billion francs worth of bonds maturing in 1997 which were repaid in 1996, the statement said.
The overall total financing requirement was slightly lower than expected.
Most analysts had said they expected a figure of 620 billion francs, made up of 320 billion francs of OAT sales and 300 billion francs of BTAN sales.
The government said the average maturity of France's debt at the end of 1996 was six years and 47 days compared with six years and 95 days at the end of 1995.
